GOLDEN-HOUR SUNSET ORANGE — low raking sun burning amber-orange across cracked salt flats, war-rig silhouetted in edge-lit copper, wheel-dust erupting in glowing plumes, long hard shadows stretching rearward across the bleached ground

DUST-STORM ORANGE FILTERED — midday sun choked through approaching haze, entire scene tinted orange-sepia, chrome dulled to brass, visibility bleeding out at mid-distance, atmospheric pressure flattening all shadow contrast

DAWN BLOOD-RED HORIZON — blood-red band scorching the horizon beneath deep-violet sky, scrap-rig silhouetted edge-red, crew crouched on the deck backlit in crimson, long cold shadows raking forward across the wasteland

HEADLIGHTS-IN-DUST CONES — twin yellow-white headlight beams punching through roiling ground-dust, hard volumetric cones projecting forward, rig body partially swallowed in its own shadow, wasteland beyond the cones in total darkness

NOON HARSH WHITE-BLEACHED — midday sun hammering straight down, all color bleached toward white, hard-edged black shadows beneath the chassis, chrome catching solar flare, dust-cloud edge burning white against pale sky

SANDSTORM SEPIA WALL — towering ochre-brown sandstorm wall consuming the horizon and upper sky, rig in foreground reading in cool desaturated tones, crew bracing into wind, the wall's scale dwarfing the machine completely

NIGHT FIRE-GLOW — dead-dark wasteland surrounding the halted rig, rear-deck flame-thrower rig burning as sole light source, orange uplight catching crew faces and welded scrap edges, ground beyond swallowed in black

DAWN COLD-BLUE WITH FIRE-PIT — cold pre-sunrise blue ambient washing the wasteland, rig-mounted fire-pit throwing warm orange uplight against the chassis underbelly, dual-tone contrast splitting the scene into cold sky and warm iron

MOLOTOV-IGNITION FOREGROUND — thermite charge detonating in extreme foreground, blinding orange-white bloom overlighting the rig, crew briefly over-exposed in the flash, hard uplight raking under jaw-lines, debris shadow flung rearward

STORM-CELL LIGHTNING FLASH — pre-storm wasteland in total darkness, actinic-white lightning fork splitting the charged sky, rig starkly silhouetted white-on-black for a single frame, pitch shadow snapping back between strikes

NEON-CYBERPUNK URBAN SCAVENGER — ruined overpass district with shattered neon tubes uplighting the rig in broken cyan and magenta bleed, wet rubble reflecting color pools, hard shadow edges cut by competing colored sources

GAS-FLARE GLOW DISTANT — burning oil-derrick far on the horizon throwing warm amber glow across the lower sky, rig catching the distant warm-side light on its left flank, right side falling into cool shadow

TWILIGHT WITH WAR-TORCHES — last grey-blue light draining from the sky, rig-mounted war-torches and crew hand-torches igniting one by one, intermediate dual-color balance between the failing cold twilight and the growing incandescent flame warmth
